■ Commands

Type these in the Kick chat. You earn credits passively just by chatting — once a minute per person.

Credits

!credits <user> (optional)

Shows your credit balance — or someone else's if you name them.also: !coins, !points, !balance

!leaderboard

Shows the top 5 credit holders.also: !top — full list on the stats page

!daily

Claims your free daily credits. Comes back around every 20 hours.

!tip <user> <amount>

Sends some of your credits to another viewer.example: !tip @friend 500 — they need to have chatted before

!site

Posts the website link in chat.

!help

Posts a short list of commands in chat.also: !commands

Casino

!gamble <amount|all>

Coinflip your credits — win and they double, lose and they're gone.example: !gamble 1000 · slots, plinko, mines, dragon tower, cases, keno, blackjack & crash live on the casino page

!plinko <amount|all>

Drops a ball on the plinko board on stream — watch it bounce down and land on your multiplier live on the overlay.example: !plinko 1000 · only while the streamer has the on-screen board switched on, usually during downtime

!enableplinko / !disableplinko

Puts the on-screen plinko board up on stream, or takes it down — the board appears in OBS straight away and chat is told either way.streamer, admins & mods · also: !plinkoon / !plinkooff · the same switch as Admin › Casino

!rob <user>

Tries to pickpocket another viewer — succeed and you take a random cut of their wealth, get caught and you pay them a fine. Stocks count on both sides: a big haul force-sells the victim's shares, and a fine you can't cover in cash dumps yours. The crime page sells gear that tips the odds (or protects you).example: !rob @friend · on a cooldown

!duel <user> <amount>

Challenges another viewer to a coinflip duel for the pot.example: !duel @friend 500 — they have 60 seconds to answer

!accept / !decline

Answers a duel challenge aimed at you.no answer within 60s = challenge expires, challenger refunded

Stock market

!stocks

Lists all tickers with current prices and 1-hour change.

!buy <ticker> <credits>

Spends credits on shares — buying pushes the price up as your order fills.example: !buy STRMR 1000

!sell <ticker> <shares|all>

Sells shares back to credits (a small fee applies) — selling pushes the price down.example: !sell STRMR all

!portfolio <user> (optional)

Shows what you own and your profit/loss — or someone else's portfolio if you name them.

Predictions

!predict <option#> <amount>

Bets on the open prediction — option is its number (1, 2, 3…).example: !predict 1 5000 · one bet per prediction · watch the odds on the Market page or the stream overlay

Raffles

!raffle [tickets]

Buys tickets in the running raffle for a real prize. Every ticket is one more entry in the hat, so the more you buy the better your odds — and the credits are spent either way, win or lose. Leave the number off to see the prize and how your odds are looking.example: !raffle 10 · also: !tickets · full prize details, the odds board and the winner on the raffles page · the streamer draws live, and a cancelled raffle refunds everyone

Fishing

!fish

Casts a line — random catch from common carp to mythic golden koi.free, on a cooldown · sell your catches & browse your collection on the fishing page

!fishsell <all|rarity|species> [count] [best|worst]

Sells the catches sitting in your net without leaving chat — the same sale as the fishing page.examples: !fishsell all · !fishsell common · !fishsell golden koi · a rarity sells that tier only, add a '-' (!fishsell rare-) to sweep everything below it too · add a count to sell part of a stack instead of all of it — !fishsell bass 1 cashes in your most valuable bass, !fishsell bass 2 worst dumps the two cheapest · unsold fish decay, so a full net is a bleeding net

!treasure

One free dig per day at a chest that pays out across the whole site — fishing gear (usually bait or a lure, with the rods, net and freezer very rare), criminal kit like a lockpick or a decoy wallet, a purse of credits, or a contract for one of your businesses.the live odds are on the fishing page · anything you can't use — a rod you already own, a manager with no shop to run — pays out worm bait or credits instead, so a dig is never wasted

!cook <item>

Cooks spare catches into gear — 3 commons make worm bait, 5 uncommons make a lucky lure.example: !cook bait · type !cook for the recipe list · eats your cheapest fish of that tier first, so trophies stay safe

!prestige

Hands in a complete collection log for the 🎣 Master Angler badge and a fresh, empty log.needs all 100 species caught on your current run · your net is cashed in on the way out · gear, credits, channel records and lifetime totals all stay · prestige again as often as you can fill the log, and the badge counts them

Business

!business

Shows what you run, what's sitting in the tills and what it all earns an hour.also: !biz · buy, upgrade and secure your businesses on the business page

!collect

Empties every till you own into your balance. A business keeps earning until its till is full and then stops, so collecting regularly is the whole game — and a boom or a business event can swing what you walk away with.also: !cashout · a manager triples how much a till can hold if you can't check in often

Trading hours

Your shops earn their full rate while the stream is live and a fraction of it once the stream ends — the money is in turning up. It makes no difference when you collect: a till that filled across a stream starting keeps both rates exactly as they happened.type !business to see whether your shops are open or shut right now

Off the books

Some of the catalog is illegal, and it pays dirty money into a separate stash that buys nothing until it's washed. It earns more per credit invested than anything legal — but every collection is a roll against the police, and a raid seizes the till, fines you and shuts the place for hours. Payoffs cut those odds by up to three quarters.!rob can't touch an illegal till — legal shops risk robbery, illegal ones risk raids

!wash

Washes dirty money through the legal businesses you run, minus a fee. Each legal shop launders a share of its own hourly income, and unused capacity banks up — so how much dirty money you can actually spend depends on how many honest fronts you keep alongside the labs.also: !launder · run nothing but illegal shops and you'll pile up money you can't touch

!empire [user]

Looks up what someone runs and what it earns.example: !empire @someone · leave the name off for your own

!rob <user>

Uncollected takings are cash in a register, and no safe or vault covers them — an untended till is the easiest money in the channel to steal. Security on a business hides up to three quarters of its till; collecting hides all of it.see the Credits tab for the rest of how !rob works · illegal tills hold dirty money, so a robber can't reach them at all

TTS

!tts <message>

Pays credits to have your message read out loud on stream.cost and rules on the home page — no links

Fun

!cock [user]

Measures your cock — or someone else's if you name them.example: !cock or !cock @someone · purely for the lols, 0–12 inches

!boobs [user]

Measures your boobs — or someone else's if you name them.example: !boobs or !boobs @someone · purely for the lols, random 34 AA–G cup

Streamer & admins

!ttson / !ttsoff

Turns TTS on or off for everyone.streamer & admins

!pump <ticker>

Shoves a stock's price up and announces it in chat.streamer & admins · example: !pump STRMR

!dump <ticker>

Shoves a stock's price down and announces it in chat.streamer & admins

!chest <amount> [trigger word]

Drops a credit chest — everyone who types the trigger word within 30 seconds splits it. The word defaults to W; anything after the amount becomes the trigger (e.g. !chest 1000 good stream).streamer only, since the credits are minted · also available from the admin panel

!frenzy [seconds|stop]

Starts a fishing frenzy — the !fish cooldown drops to zero for everyone until it ends, announced in chat and bannered on the overlay. Defaults to the length set in Admin › Fishing (30s); !frenzy stop ends one early.streamer & admins · also: !fishfrenzy / !fishingfrenzy · also available from the admin panel

!boom [hours]

Drops that many hours of takings into every business till in the channel at once, announced in chat. A full till can't take any more, so a boom rewards whoever has been collecting.streamer & admins, since the credits are minted · also: !businessboom · also available from the admin panel

<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Credits · Casino</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/theme.css?v=3">
<style>
  :root {
    /* the game shell rides the shared theme — one accent, one set of lines */
    --pk-panel: var(--panel2); --pk-game: var(--void); --pk-line: var(--line); --pk-input: var(--inset);
    --pk-text: var(--ink); --pk-muted: var(--dim); --pk-blue: var(--accent);
    --pk-yellow: var(--gold); --pk-danger: var(--red-text);
  }
  section.card, #rb-card { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto 20px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .game-head { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto 20px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .lobby-link { display: inline-block; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; }
  .lobby-link:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  .game-title { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink);
    letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

  .pk-stack { max-width: 760px; margin: auto; width: 100%; }
  .pk-canvas-wrap { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 760/570; }

  .pk-seg button.active { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }

  .pk-row { display: flex; }

  .pkui input:focus, .pkui select:focus { border-color: var(--pk-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--pk-blue); }

  .pk-primary {
    width: 100%; border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
    padding: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 16px -4px var(--accent-glow);
  }
  .pk-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-bright); }
  .pk-primary.stop { background: var(--green-text); color: #04140d; box-shadow: none; }

    .pk-bin { border-radius: 2px; font-size: clamp(6px, 1.8vw, 8px); box-shadow: 0 2px var(--shadow); }
    .pk-last-wins { width: clamp(24px, 7vw, 32px); }
    .pk-last-win { font-size: clamp(8px, 2.2vw, 10px); }
  }

  /* ============ MINES ============ */
  .mn-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px; max-width: 430px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .mn-tile {
    aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 2px; background: #24242a;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    line-height: 1; transition: background .15s, transform .08s;
  }
  .mn-tile:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2b2b34; transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .mn-tile:disabled { opacity: 1; }
  .mn-tile.gem { background: rgba(50, 164, 103, 0.22); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #32a467; }
  .mn-tile.boom { background: rgba(205, 66, 70, 0.4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #cd4246; }
  .mn-tile.mine-dim { opacity: 0.55; }
  .mn-tile.idle { opacity: 0.55; }
  /* Custom gem / bomb artwork (see the #mn-sprite symbols). Sized off the
     tile itself so it scales with the grid instead of a fixed font-size. */
  .mn-ico {
    width: 68%; height: 68%; display: block; pointer-events: none;
    animation: mn-pop .22s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.5, .5, 1) both;
  }
  .mn-ico.bomb-ico { width: 78%; height: 78%; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5)); }
  .mn-ico.boom-ico { width: 88%; height: 88%; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(249, 115, 22, .6)); }
  .mn-ico.gem-ico { filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45)); }
  @keyframes mn-pop { from { transform: scale(.35); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .mn-ico { animation: none; } }

  /* ============ DRAGON TOWER ============ */
  /* Nine rows stacked bottom-to-top, so the tower is climbed upwards on
     screen. Each row carries its own multiplier label on the right. */
  .dt-tower {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 6px;
    max-width: 430px; margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .dt-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .dt-tiles { flex: 1; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
  .dt-mult {
    width: 70px; flex: 0 0 70px; text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--pk-muted); opacity: .5;
  }
  .dt-row.here .dt-mult { opacity: 1; color: var(--pk-text); }
  .dt-row.cleared .dt-mult { opacity: 1; color: #62d96b; }
  .dt-tile {
    aspect-ratio: 2.1; border-radius: 2px; background: #24242a;
    font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; opacity: .55;
    transition: background .15s, transform .08s, opacity .15s;
  }
  .dt-row.here .dt-tile { opacity: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3a3a45; }
  .dt-row.here .dt-tile:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2b2b34; transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .dt-tile:disabled { cursor: default; }
  .dt-tile.egg { background: rgba(50, 164, 103, 0.22); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #32a467; opacity: 1; }
  .dt-tile.egg-dim { background: #1c1c22; opacity: .7; }
  .dt-tile.skull { background: #1c1c22; opacity: .7; }
  .dt-tile.boom { background: rgba(205, 66, 70, 0.4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #cd4246; opacity: 1; }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .dt-tile { font-size: 16px; }
    .dt-mult { width: 56px; flex: 0 0 56px; font-size: 11px; }
  }

  /* ============ CASES ============ */
  /* A strip of cases slides past a fixed marker and stops on the tier the
     server already picked. The filler cases are drawn from the same odds
     table, so the blur of the spin shows the mix a real stop would. */
  .cs-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .cs-recent { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; min-height: 28px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .cs-pill {
    padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 999px; color: #0a0a0c;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .cs-stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 30px 0 46px; }
  /* the reel fades out into the panel instead of being clipped mid-case */
  .cs-stage::before, .cs-stage::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 13%; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .cs-stage::before { left: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pk-game), transparent); }
  .cs-stage::after { right: 0; background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--pk-game), transparent); }
  .cs-marker {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0; z-index: 2;
    border-left: 1px dashed rgba(244, 245, 247, .18); transform: translateX(-.5px);
  }
  /* one pointer, at the top — the bottom of the marker is where the winning
     case hangs its multiplier tag */
  .cs-marker i {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 0; height: 0; transform: translateX(-50%);
    border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent;
    border-top: 11px solid var(--pk-text);
  }
  .cs-reel { display: flex; gap: var(--cs-gap, 14px); will-change: transform; }
  .cs-reel.spin { transition: transform var(--cs-ms, 2600ms) cubic-bezier(.12, .78, .22, 1); }
  .cs-case {
    position: relative; flex: 0 0 var(--cs-size, 92px);
    width: var(--cs-size, 92px); height: var(--cs-size, 92px);
    border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c);
    transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
  }
  /* the label plate on the lid, the seam, and the latch under it */
  .cs-case::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 15%; right: 15%; top: 13%; height: 26%;
    border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .32);
  }
  .cs-case::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 55%; height: 4%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
  }
  .cs-case b {
    position: absolute; left: 40%; right: 40%; top: 59%; height: 9%;
    border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62);
  }
  .cs-case.win { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--pk-text), 0 6px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55); z-index: 4; }
  .cs-tag {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -27px; transform: translateX(-50%);
    padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2a2a33; color: var(--pk-text);
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
  .cs-legend { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 4px; }
  .cs-swatch {
    width: 34px; height: 22px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c);
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .72);
    font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; cursor: default;
  }
  .cs-odds { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
  .cs-odds th {
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f6f78;
    font-weight: 700; text-align: right; padding: 6px 2px;
  }
  .cs-odds th:first-child { text-align: left; }
  .cs-odds td { padding: 7px 2px; text-align: right; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .cs-odds td:first-child { text-align: left; }
  .cs-odds i { display: inline-block; width: 26px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--c); vertical-align: -1px; }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .cs-stage { padding: 22px 0 34px; }
    .cs-pill { padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .cs-reel.spin { transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
  }

  /* ============ KENO ============ */
  /* A board of 40, a payout row under it with one column per possible hit
     count, and a draw that lands one ball at a time. The payout row grows and
     shrinks with the selection — that's the game's whole pitch made visible:
     select more numbers and the row gets longer and its far end gets richer. */
  .kn-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .kn-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
  .kn-cell {
    aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 5px; background: #24242a; color: var(--pk-text);
    font-size: clamp(12px, 2.6vw, 16px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; position: relative;
    transition: background .12s, transform .08s, box-shadow .12s, color .12s;
  }
  .kn-cell:hover:not(:disabled):not(.sel) { background: #2b2b34; transform: translateY(-2px); }
  /* The board locks while the draw lands, and for a whole autobet run —
     greying it out would hide the result the reveal is there to show. Needs
     to outrank .pkui button:disabled, hence the extra class. */
  .pkui .kn-cell:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 1; }
  .kn-cell.sel { background: #8b5cf6; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #5b21b6; }
  /* drawn but not picked — a ring, so a near miss is visible without shouting */
  .kn-cell.drawn { background: #1c1c22; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #3f3f4a; color: var(--pk-muted); }
  /* picked and drawn: the hit */
  .kn-cell.sel.drawn { background: #f2b53c; color: #221a05; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #a3730f; }
  .kn-cell.pop { animation: knPop .32s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes knPop { 40% { transform: scale(1.18); } }

  /* payout row: one column per hit count, 0 hits on the left */
  .kn-pays { display: grid; gap: 5px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .kn-pay {
    background: var(--pk-input); border: 1px solid var(--pk-line); border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 9px 2px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: clamp(9px, 1.9vw, 12px); color: var(--pk-text);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background .15s, color .15s;
    overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;   /* eleven columns is a tight fit */
  }
  .kn-pay.dead { color: var(--pk-muted); }        /* pays nothing at this hit count */
  /* where the round landed — gold when it paid, red when it didn't, so the
     highlight never dresses a loss up as a win */
  .kn-pay.landed { background: #f2b53c; border-color: #f2b53c; color: #221a05; font-weight: 700; }
  .kn-pay.landed.dead { background: rgba(205, 66, 70, .38); border-color: #cd4246; color: var(--pk-text); }
  .kn-hits {
    display: grid; gap: 5px; margin-top: 5px; padding: 7px 2px;
    background: var(--pk-input); border: 1px solid var(--pk-line); border-radius: 3px;
  }
  .kn-hit {
    text-align: center; font-size: clamp(9px, 1.9vw, 12px); color: var(--pk-muted);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; gap: 4px;
  }
  .kn-hit i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #3f3f4a; }
  .kn-hit.landed { color: var(--pk-text); font-weight: 700; }
  .kn-hit.landed i { background: #f2b53c; }
  .kn-hit.landed.dead i { background: #cd4246; }

  .kn-odds { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
  .kn-odds th {
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f6f78;
    font-weight: 700; text-align: right; padding: 6px 2px;
  }
  .kn-odds th:first-child { text-align: left; }
  .kn-odds td { padding: 6px 2px; text-align: right; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .kn-odds td:first-child { text-align: left; }
  .kn-odds tr.dead td { color: var(--pk-muted); }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .kn-grid { gap: 4px; }
    .kn-cell { border-radius: 4px; }
    .kn-pays, .kn-hits { gap: 3px; }
    .kn-pay { padding: 7px 1px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .kn-cell.pop { animation: none; }
  }

  /* shared action buttons (blackjack hit/stand/double/split, keno's random
     pick / clear table), two per row */
  .pk-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; }
  .pk-actions button {
    background: #202028; color: var(--pk-text);
    padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
  }
  .pk-actions button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2b2b34; }

  /* ============ BLACKJACK ============ */
  /* Cards fly out of the shoe and flip in 3D. The table itself is
     unpainted — the cards sit straight on the game panel. */
  .bj-table {
    --bj-green: #00e701; --bj-red: #ed4163; --bj-gold: #ffd45c;
    --bj-muted: #9aa1ad;
    --bj-card-w: 104px; --bj-card-h: 146px;
    color: #fff;
    position: relative; margin-bottom: 12px;
    min-height: 460px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 26px 12px 22px;
  }
  .bj-shoe { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 14px; width: 52px; height: 40px; }
  .bj-shoe i {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 5px;
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, #3a3a45, #17171c);
    border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
  }
  .bj-shoe i:nth-child(2) { transform: translateY(3px) scale(.985); }
  .bj-shoe i:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(6px) scale(.97); }
  .bj-shoe.pulse { animation: bjShoeTap .28s ease; }
  @keyframes bjShoeTap { 50% { transform: scale(.9) translateY(2px); } }

  .bj-seat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .bj-badge {
    min-width: 76px; padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 20px;
    background: #24242c; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; text-align: center;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    transition: background .25s, color .25s, transform .18s;
  }
  .bj-badge.pop { animation: bjPop .3s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes bjPop { 40% { transform: scale(1.22); } }
  .bj-badge.bust { background: #3a1a24; color: var(--bj-red); }
  .bj-badge.win { background: #0d3d1c; color: var(--bj-green); }
  .bj-badge.bj { background: #3d2f0e; color: var(--bj-gold); }
  .bj-badge.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  .bj-cards { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--bj-card-h); }
  .bj-hands-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .bj-hand-wrap {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px; border-radius: 14px; border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color .25s, background .25s, opacity .25s;
  }
  .bj-hand-wrap.active { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .18); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03); }
  .bj-hand-wrap.settled { opacity: .55; }
  .bj-hand-wrap.split { --bj-card-w: 78px; --bj-card-h: 110px; }

  .bj-card { width: var(--bj-card-w); height: var(--bj-card-h); perspective: 900px; flex: none; will-change: transform, opacity; }
  .bj-card + .bj-card { margin-left: calc(var(--bj-card-w) * -0.62); }
  .bj-card-inner {
    position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 9px;
    transform-style: preserve-3d; -webkit-transform-style: preserve-3d;
    transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.3, .9, .3, 1);
  }
  .bj-card.down .bj-card-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
  /* Shadows live on the faces, not on .bj-card-inner — a filter on a
     preserve-3d element flattens the 3D context and mirrors the front. */
  .bj-face {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden;
    backface-visibility: hidden; -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
    transform: rotateY(0deg); box-shadow: -3px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
  }
  .bj-front {
    background: #fff; color: #111;
    padding: 7px 9px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .bj-front .bj-rank { font-size: calc(var(--bj-card-h) * .23); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
  .bj-front .bj-suit { font-size: calc(var(--bj-card-h) * .24); line-height: 1; margin-top: 2px; }
  .bj-front.red { color: #e8112d; }
  .bj-back {
    transform: rotateY(180deg); display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(155deg, #43434f, #17171c); border: 3px solid #fff;
  }
  .bj-back .bj-diamond {
    width: 56%; height: 74%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);
    border-radius: 48% 6% 48% 6%; display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-size: calc(var(--bj-card-h) * .16); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; letter-spacing: .5px;
  }
  .bj-card.busted .bj-front { filter: grayscale(.55) brightness(.82); }
  .bj-hand-wrap.shake { animation: bjShake .4s; }
  @keyframes bjShake {
    20% { transform: translateX(-7px); } 45% { transform: translateX(6px); }
    70% { transform: translateX(-4px); } 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  }

  .bj-ribbon {
    position: relative; text-align: center; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .17);
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.2px; line-height: 1.9;
    user-select: none; z-index: 1;
  }
  .bj-ribbon b { display: block; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .2); }

  .bj-toast {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.8);
    padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 12, .9); border: 2px solid var(--bj-green);
    color: var(--bj-green); font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: .5px;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9; white-space: nowrap;
    transition: opacity .25s, transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1);
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  }
  .bj-toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  .bj-toast.lose { border-color: var(--bj-red); color: var(--bj-red); }
  .bj-toast.push { border-color: var(--bj-muted); color: var(--bj-muted); }
  .bj-toast.bj { border-color: var(--bj-gold); color: var(--bj-gold); }

  /* Below 720px the shell stacks the side panel under the game (see
     .pk-shell), so everything the hand needs has to share one screen. The
     table gives up its desktop breathing room, the ribbon goes — the hint
     under the table already spells out the same two rules — and hit/stand
     ride straight under the cards instead of below the bet box. */
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .bj-table {
      /* both seats plus a gap between them — space-between owns the slack, and
         with the ribbon gone that gap is all that separates dealer from player */
      min-height: calc(var(--bj-card-h) * 2 + 136px);
      padding: 12px 8px 10px;
    }
    .bj-seat, .bj-hand-wrap { gap: 6px; }
    .bj-hand-wrap { padding: 2px; }
    .bj-hands-row { gap: 8px; }
    .bj-ribbon { display: none; }
    .bj-actions { order: -1; }
    .bj-actions .pk-actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 460px) {
    .bj-table { --bj-card-w: 84px; --bj-card-h: 118px; }
    /* split hands sit side by side on a phone only if they shrink properly */
    .bj-hand-wrap.split { --bj-card-w: 56px; --bj-card-h: 79px; }
    .bj-hand-wrap.split .bj-badge { min-width: 52px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 15px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .bj-table *, .bj-table *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
  }

  /* ============ SLOTS ============ */
  /* The machine itself is a Pixi canvas; everything around it is ordinary
     page furniture so it matches the rest of the casino. */
  .sl-stage { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .sl-stage canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 3px; }
  .sl-pay { max-width: 700px; margin: 14px auto 0; border: 1px solid var(--pk-line); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--pk-panel); }
  .sl-pay > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--pk-muted); }
  .sl-pay > summary:hover { color: var(--pk-text); }
  .sl-pay > div { padding: 0 12px 12px; }
  .sl-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
  .sl-table th { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f6f78; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; padding: 6px 2px; }
  .sl-table th:first-child { text-align: left; }
  .sl-table td { padding: 7px 2px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .sl-table td:first-child { text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }
  .sl-sym {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-right: 3px; border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1;
  }
  .sl-sym.glyph { background: #121216; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3a3a44; }
  .sl-sym.glyph.red { background: #150c0e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(198,40,40,.55); }
  .sl-sym.scatter { background: #18080a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #c62828; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .sl-sym img { width: 21px; height: 21px; object-fit: contain; }
  .sl-fs { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(198,40,40,.3); }
  .sl-fs p { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--pk-muted); line-height: 1.5; }

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
// the plinko ball and the crash curve are drawn, not styled — they read the
// live accent token so they follow Admin > Appearance like everything else
const accentColour = () =>
  getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--accent").trim() || "#00d4ff";

/* ================= CASINO MASTER SWITCH ================= */
// When the admin turns the casino off, lock every game's action button so it
// can't be clicked (e.g. Plinko's Drop Ball) and grey the boards out. Each
// game's own updateUI() keeps re-computing its button's disabled state from
// bet validity, so a one-time disable won't stick — we watch each button and
// force it back to disabled whenever something tries to re-enable it.
let _casinoLocked = false;
function applyCasinoState(enabled) {
  const off = enabled === false;
  document.body.classList.toggle("casino-off", off);

/* Every game's 2× button. Doubling past what you actually have just puts the
   whole balance in the box instead of a bet that would be rejected. The cap is
   skipped when there's no balance to cap against — not logged in, or the page
   hasn't heard back yet — so the button still behaves like plain doubling. */
function doubleBet(input) {
  const min = Math.max(1, Number(input.min) || 1);
  const want = Math.max(min, Math.floor(Number(input.value) || 0) * 2);
  const cap = Math.floor(BALANCE);
  input.value = cap >= min ? Math.min(want, cap) : want;
}

/* ================= PLINKO ================= */
(() => {
  if (!window.Matter) { $("betMsg").textContent = "Physics engine failed to load — check connection."; return; }
  const PADDING_X=52, PADDING_TOP=36, PADDING_BOTTOM=28, AUTO_MS=550;
  const PIN_CATEGORY=0x0001, BALL_CATEGORY=0x0002;
  const rowOptions=[8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16];
  const frictionAirByRowCount={8:.0395,9:.041,10:.038,11:.0355,12:.0414,13:.0437,14:.0401,15:.0418,16:.0364};
  const red={r:205,g:66,b:70}, yellow={r:251,g:208,b:101}, sred={r:125,g:35,b:40}, syellow={r:160,g:125,b:50};
  const M=Matter, canvas=$('board');

  const st={tables:null,loggedIn:false,serverBalance:0,rowCount:16,risk:'medium',

  rowOptions.forEach(n=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=n;o.textContent=n;if(n===16)o.selected=true;$('rowCount').append(o)});
  const lerp=(a,b,t)=>Math.round(a+(b-a)*t);
  function colors(count){const even=count%2===0, half=Math.ceil(count/2), bg=[], sh=[];
    for(let i=0;i<half;i++){const t=half===1?0:i/(half-1);
      bg.push(`rgb(${lerp(red.r,yellow.r,t)}, ${lerp(red.g,yellow.g,t)}, ${lerp(red.b,yellow.b,t)})`);
      sh.push(`rgb(${lerp(sred.r,syellow.r,t)}, ${lerp(sred.g,syellow.g,t)}, ${lerp(sred.b,syellow.b,t)})`)}
    return {bg:[...bg,...bg.slice().reverse().slice(even?0:1)],sh:[...sh,...sh.slice().reverse().slice(even?0:1)]}}
  const fmt=n=>Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
  const pinDistanceX=()=>(canvas.width-PADDING_X*2)/((3+st.rowCount-1)-1);
  const pinRadius=()=>(24-st.rowCount)/2;

  const engine=M.Engine.create({timing:{timeScale:1}});
  const render=M.Render.create({engine,canvas,options:{width:760,height:570,background:'#101014',wireframes:false}});
  const runner=M.Runner.create();

  function placePinsAndWalls(){
    if(st.pins.length)M.Composite.remove(engine.world,st.pins);
    if(st.walls.length)M.Composite.remove(engine.world,st.walls);
    st.pins=[];st.walls=[];st.lastRowX=[];
    for(let row=0;row<st.rowCount;row++){
      const y=PADDING_TOP+((canvas.height-PADDING_TOP-PADDING_BOTTOM)/(st.rowCount-1))*row;
      const rowPaddingX=PADDING_X+((st.rowCount-1-row)*pinDistanceX())/2;
      for(let col=0;col<3+row;col++){
        const colX=rowPaddingX+((canvas.width-rowPaddingX*2)/(3+row-1))*col;
        const pin=M.Bodies.circle(colX,y,pinRadius(),{isStatic:true,render:{fillStyle:'#c5cbd3'},collisionFilter:{category:PIN_CATEGORY,mask:BALL_CATEGORY}});
        st.pins.push(pin);
        if(row===st.rowCount-1)st.lastRowX.push(colX);
      }}
    M.Composite.add(engine.world,st.pins);
    const firstPinX=st.pins[0].position.x;
    const leftWallAngle=Math.atan2(firstPinX-st.lastRowX[0],canvas.height-PADDING_TOP-PADDING_BOTTOM);
    const leftWallX=firstPinX-(firstPinX-st.lastRowX[0])/2-pinDistanceX()*.25;
    const leftWall=M.Bodies.rectangle(leftWallX,canvas.height/2,10,canvas.height,{isStatic:true,angle:leftWallAngle,render:{visible:false}});
    const rightWall=M.Bodies.rectangle(canvas.width-leftWallX,canvas.height/2,10,canvas.height,{isStatic:true,angle:-leftWallAngle,render:{visible:false}});
    st.walls=[leftWall,rightWall];M.Composite.add(engine.world,st.walls);
    renderBins();
  }

  const sensor=M.Bodies.rectangle(canvas.width/2,canvas.height,canvas.width,10,{isSensor:true,isStatic:true,render:{visible:false}});
  M.Composite.add(engine.world,[sensor]);
  M.Events.on(engine,'collisionStart',({pairs})=>pairs.forEach(({bodyA,bodyB})=>{
    if(bodyA===sensor){finishBall(bodyB);return;} if(bodyB===sensor){finishBall(bodyA);return;}
    const ball=(bodyA.plugin&&bodyA.plugin.targets)?bodyA:((bodyB.plugin&&bodyB.plugin.targets)?bodyB:null);
    if(ball){
      const tx=targetXFor(ball), dir=Math.sign(tx-ball.position.x)||((Math.random()<.5)?-1:1);
      M.Body.setVelocity(ball,{x:dir*(0.6+Math.random()*1.3),y:ball.velocity.y});
    }
  }));

  function targetXFor(ball){
    // steer toward the gap in the NEXT pin row below the ball. Aiming at the
    // current row's gap points straight at a pin one row down (rows are offset
    // half a gap), which parked balls on peg tops.
    const gapY=(canvas.height-PADDING_TOP-PADDING_BOTTOM)/(st.rowCount-1);
    const r=Math.max(0,Math.min(st.rowCount-1,Math.floor((ball.position.y-PADDING_TOP)/gapY)+1));
    return ball.plugin.targets[r];
  }
  M.Events.on(engine,'afterUpdate',()=>{
    M.Composite.allBodies(engine.world).forEach(ball=>{
      if(!(ball.plugin&&ball.plugin.targets))return;
      const dx=Math.max(-40,Math.min(40,targetXFor(ball)-ball.position.x));
      const depth=(ball.position.y-PADDING_TOP)/(canvas.height-PADDING_TOP);
      M.Body.applyForce(ball,ball.position,{x:dx*ball.mass*(0.00010+0.00018*Math.max(0,depth)),y:0});
      // unstick: if a ball settles on a peg, hop it toward its target like a real bounce
      if(ball.speed<0.35){
        ball.plugin.slow=(ball.plugin.slow||0)+1;
        if(ball.plugin.slow>10){
          const dir=Math.sign(targetXFor(ball)-ball.position.x)||(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);
          M.Body.setVelocity(ball,{x:dir*(0.9+Math.random()*0.6),y:-1.6});
          ball.plugin.slow=0;
        }
      } else {
        ball.plugin.slow=0;
      }
      if(ball.plugin.born+15000<Date.now())finishBall(ball);
    });
  });

  async function dropBall(){

    st.dropping=true;
    const bet=Math.floor(Number($('betAmount').value));
    let data;
    try{
      const r=await fetch('/api/plinko',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({bet,risk:st.risk,rows:st.rowCount})});

    }catch(e){st.dropping=false;resetAuto();return;}

    $('betMsg').textContent='';
    st.serverBalance=data.balance;
    setBalance(BALANCE-bet);          // payout lands when the ball does

    const gap=pinDistanceX(); let off=0;
    const targets=data.path.map(d=>{off+=d?0.5:-0.5;return canvas.width/2+off*gap;});
    const ballOffsetRangeX=gap*.8, ballRadius=pinRadius()*2;
    const ball=M.Bodies.circle(canvas.width/2-ballOffsetRangeX+Math.random()*ballOffsetRangeX*2,0,ballRadius,
      {restitution:.8,friction:.05,frictionStatic:0,frictionAir:frictionAirByRowCount[st.rowCount],
       collisionFilter:{category:BALL_CATEGORY,mask:PIN_CATEGORY},render:{fillStyle:accentColour()}});
    ball.plugin={targets,slot:data.slot,multiplier:data.multiplier,payout:data.payout,bet,rows:st.rowCount,born:Date.now(),finished:false};
    M.Composite.add(engine.world,ball);
    st.openBalls++;
    updateUI();
  }

  function finishBall(ball){
    if(!(ball.plugin&&ball.plugin.targets)||ball.plugin.finished)return;
    ball.plugin.finished=true;
    const p=ball.plugin;
    if(window.sfx){ if(p.multiplier>=10)sfx.bigwin(); else if(p.multiplier>=2)sfx.win(); else if(p.multiplier<1)sfx.lose(); }

    renderLastWins();
    M.Composite.remove(engine.world,ball);
    st.openBalls=Math.max(0,st.openBalls-1);
    setBalance(st.openBalls===0?st.serverBalance:BALANCE+p.payout);
    updateUI();
  }

  function renderBins(){
    if(!st.tables)return;
    const payouts=st.tables[st.rowCount][st.risk];
    const cs=colors(st.rowCount+1), inner=$('binsInner'); inner.innerHTML='';
    const pct=(st.lastRowX.at(-1)-st.lastRowX[0])/canvas.width*100; inner.style.width=pct+'%';
    payouts.forEach((p,i)=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='pk-bin';
      d.style.background=cs.bg[i];d.style.setProperty('--shadow',cs.sh[i]);

  }
  function renderLastWins(){
    const box=$('lastWins');box.innerHTML='';
    st.wins.slice(-4).reverse().forEach(w=>{
      const cs=colors(w.rows+1);const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='pk-last-win';

  function validate(){
    if(!st.loggedIn){$('betMsg').textContent='Log in on the home page to play.';$('dropBtn').disabled=true;return false;}

  function updateUI(){

    $('riskLevel').disabled=busy; $('rowCount').disabled=busy;
    $('manualMode').disabled=!!st.autoTimer; $('autoMode').disabled=!!st.autoTimer;

    $('dropBtn').textContent=st.mode==='manual'?'Drop Ball':(st.autoTimer?'Stop Autobet':'Start Autobet');
    $('dropBtn').classList.toggle('stop',!!st.autoTimer);
    $('statBets').textContent=st.wins.length;
    $('statProfit').textContent=(st.totalProfit<0?'-':'')+fmt(Math.abs(st.totalProfit));
    $('statBest').textContent=(Math.max(0,...st.wins.map(w=>w.multiplier)))+'×';

  /* The board owns two rAF loops of its own — the physics step and the canvas
     redraw — and neither one knows the tab it sits on is hidden. Left running
     they step 150-odd pins and repaint an invisible canvas sixty times a second
     behind whatever game you are actually playing, which is most of why the
     slots next door stuttered. Park both while the board is off screen, but
     keep stepping while a ball is still falling so it lands and pays even if
     you tab away mid-drop. */
  function syncBoard(){
    runner.enabled=st.visible||st.openBalls>0;
    if(st.visible===st.renderOn)return;
    st.renderOn=st.visible;
    if(st.visible)M.Render.run(render); else M.Render.stop(render);
  }
  new IntersectionObserver(es=>{st.visible=es[0].isIntersecting;syncBoard();}).observe(canvas);
  function resetAuto(){if(st.autoTimer){clearInterval(st.autoTimer);st.autoTimer=null;st.autoLeft=null;updateUI();}}

  })();
})();

  const st = {

  /* ---------- the machine's own voice ----------
     A lever clack on the spin and a thunk per reel, synthesised like the rest
     of the page's audio. Wins reuse the shared casino sfx so the whole casino
     still sounds like itself. */
  const audio = (() => {
    let ctx = null, master = null, noiseBuf = null;
    function ac() {
      if (!ctx) {
        const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AC) return null;

        master.gain.value = 0.22;

    function envelope(t0, dur, peak, attack) {
      const g = ctx.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(peak, t0 + (attack || 0.006));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
      g.connect(master);
      return g;
    }
    function tone(freq, dur, type, peak, glideTo) {
      const t0 = ctx.currentTime;
      const o = ctx.createOscillator();
      o.type = type || "sine";
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
      if (glideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glideTo, t0 + dur);
      o.connect(envelope(t0, dur, peak || 0.4));
      o.start(t0);
      o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
    }
    function burst(dur, peak, freq, q) {
      const t0 = ctx.currentTime;
      if (!noiseBuf) {
        const len = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * 0.5);
        noiseBuf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
        const d = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      }
      const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
      src.buffer = noiseBuf;
      const bp = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      bp.type = "bandpass";
      bp.frequency.value = freq;
      bp.Q.value = q || 1;
      src.connect(bp);
      bp.connect(envelope(t0, dur, peak, 0.002));
      src.start(t0);
      src.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
    }
    const safe = (fn) => { try { if (ac()) fn(); } catch (e) {} };
    return {
      spin: () => safe(() => { burst(0.09, 0.5, 1800, 2); tone(180, 0.28, "sawtooth", 0.2, 620); }),
      reelStop: (i) => safe(() => { burst(0.07, 0.4, 320, 1.4); tone(120 - i * 6, 0.13, "triangle", 0.3, 62); }),
    };
  })();

  /* ---------- symbol art ---------- */
  let symDefs = [], textures = [], totalWeight = 0, SCATTER_ID = 10;

  const hexNum = (c) => parseInt(c.slice(1), 16);
  const isRed = (c) => { const n = hexNum(c); return ((n >> 16) & 255) > 0x90 && ((n >> 8) & 255) < 0x60; };

  function randomSymbolId() {
    let r = Math.random() * totalWeight;
    for (const d of symDefs) { r -= d.weight; if (r <= 0) return d.id; }
    return symDefs[0].id;
  }

  const isAnimated = (url) => /\.gif(\?|#|$)/i.test(url);

  // Every symbol wears a channel emote, so the art has to be in hand before the
  // reels are baked. A symbol whose emote never arrives falls back to the
  // letterform or suit it is named after, and the machine is built regardless.
  function loadSymbolArt(defs) {
    return Promise.all(defs.map((def) => new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!def.image) return resolve();
      const img = new Image();
      img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";   // the tile is baked into a WebGL texture
      if (isAnimated(def.image)) {
        // a gif only advances while it is laid out, and the reels read their
        // frames straight off this element — so it lives, invisible, on the page
        img.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        img.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px;"
          + "opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1";
        document.body.appendChild(img);
      }
      // a host that never answers must not hold the machine hostage
      const giveUp = setTimeout(resolve, 6000);
      const done = (art) => { clearTimeout(giveUp); def.art = art; resolve(); };
      img.onload = () => done(img);
      img.onerror = () => done(null);
      img.src = def.image;
    })));
  }

  // an emote inset into a tile, scaled to fit `box` without distorting it
  function emoteSprite(art, S, box) {
    const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(PIXI.Texture.from(art));
    sp.scale.set(Math.min(box / art.width, box / art.height));
    sp.anchor.set(0.5);
    sp.position.set(S / 2, S / 2);
    return sp;
  }

  // the plate the premium symbols sit on
  function symbolPlate(S, red) {
    const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    g.beginFill(red ? 0x150c0e : 0x121216, 0.95).drawRoundedRect(8, 8, S - 16, S - 16, 14).endFill();
    g.lineStyle(1.5, red ? RED : 0x3a3a44, red ? 0.5 : 0.9).drawRoundedRect(8, 8, S - 16, S - 16, 14);
    return g;
  }

  // The tile a symbol is drawn on. `kind` decides how it is mounted — bare for
  // the lows, a plate for the premiums — and the emote takes the place of the
  // letterform inside that mount, so the tiers still read apart at a glance.
  function buildTile(def, S) {
    const tile = new PIXI.Container();
    if (def.kind === "rank") {
      // low symbols: bare engraved letterforms, no tile behind them
      if (def.art) { tile.addChild(emoteSprite(def.art, S, S - 16)); return tile; }
      const t = new PIXI.Text(def.label, new PIXI.TextStyle({
        fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
        fontSize: def.label.length > 1 ? 58 : 72, fontWeight: "700",
        fill: def.colour, stroke: "#000000", strokeThickness: 5, lineJoin: "round",
        letterSpacing: 1, dropShadow: true, dropShadowColor: "#000000",
        dropShadowAlpha: 0.8, dropShadowBlur: 3, dropShadowDistance: 3,
      }));
      t.anchor.set(0.5);
      t.position.set(S / 2, S / 2);
      tile.addChild(t);
    } else if (def.kind === "scatter") {
      const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
      g.beginFill(0x18080a).drawRoundedRect(7, 7, S - 14, S - 14, 12).endFill();
      g.lineStyle(2, RED, 0.9).drawRoundedRect(7, 7, S - 14, S - 14, 12);
      g.lineStyle(1, RED, 0.28).drawRoundedRect(13, 13, S - 26, S - 26, 8);
      tile.addChild(g);
      const t = new PIXI.Text(def.label, new PIXI.TextStyle({
        fontFamily: "Georgia, serif", fontSize: 42, fontWeight: "700",
        fill: def.colour, stroke: "#4a0d10", strokeThickness: 4, letterSpacing: 2,
        dropShadow: true, dropShadowColor: "#e03131", dropShadowAlpha: 0.55,
        dropShadowBlur: 8, dropShadowDistance: 0,
      }));
      t.anchor.set(0.5);
      t.position.set(S / 2, S / 2 + 1);
      tile.addChild(t);
    } else {
      // premiums: a dark plate with a hairline, glyph in bone or red
      const red = isRed(def.colour);
      tile.addChild(symbolPlate(S, red));
      if (def.art) { tile.addChild(emoteSprite(def.art, S, S - 26)); return tile; }
      const t = new PIXI.Text(def.label, new PIXI.TextStyle({
        fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
        fontSize: def.label === "7" ? 72 : 62, fontWeight: "700", fill: def.colour,
        dropShadow: true, dropShadowColor: red ? "#e03131" : "#000000",
        dropShadowAlpha: red ? 0.45 : 0.7, dropShadowBlur: red ? 10 : 4,
        dropShadowDistance: red ? 0 : 3,
      }));
      t.anchor.set(0.5);
      t.position.set(S / 2, S / 2 + 2);
      tile.addChild(t);
    }
    return tile;
  }

  // Tiles that hold a gif can't be baked once and forgotten — they keep their
  // container and are re-rendered into their own texture while the emote plays.
  const livingTiles = [];
  const GIF_FPS = 20;

  function bakeSymbols(defs) {
    const S = 100;
    return defs.map((def) => {
      const tile = buildTile(def, S);
      if (def.art && isAnimated(def.image)) {
        const tex = PIXI.RenderTexture.create({ width: S, height: S, resolution: 2 });
        app.renderer.render(tile, { renderTexture: tex });
        livingTiles.push({ tile, tex, base: PIXI.Texture.from(def.art).baseTexture });
        return tex;
      }
      const tex = app.renderer.generateTexture(tile, {
        resolution: 2, region: new PIXI.Rectangle(0, 0, S, S),
      });
      tile.destroy({ children: true });
      return tex;
    });
  }

  // Re-uploading the <img> hands us whichever frame the browser is showing, so
  // the reels play the gif without anything having to decode it. This rides the
  // machine's own ticker, which is parked whenever the cabinet is off screen.
  function playAnimatedSymbols() {
    if (!livingTiles.length) return;
    let since = 0;
    app.ticker.add(() => {
      since += app.ticker.elapsedMS;
      if (since < 1000 / GIF_FPS) return;
      since = 0;
      for (const t of livingTiles) {
        t.base.update();
        app.renderer.render(t.tile, { renderTexture: t.tex });
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- the room ---------- */
  function paintScene() {
    const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    g.beginFill(INK).drawRect(0, 0, STAGE_W, STAGE_H).endFill();
    // one soft ember of red behind the cabinet — the only colour in the room
    const steps = 26, maxR = Math.max(STAGE_W, STAGE_H) * 0.58;
    for (let i = steps; i > 0; i--) {
      const t = i / steps;
      g.beginFill(0x6e1219, 0.03 * (1 - t) + 0.004);
      g.drawCircle(STAGE_W / 2, STAGE_H * 0.42, maxR * t);
      g.endFill();
    }
    // vignette: darkness closing in from every edge
    const v = 16;
    for (let i = 0; i < v; i++) {
      const a = 0.055 * (1 - i / v), d = i / v;
      g.beginFill(0x000000, a);
      g.drawRect(0, 0, STAGE_W, STAGE_H * 0.16 * (1 - d) + 2);
      g.drawRect(0, STAGE_H - (STAGE_H * 0.2 * (1 - d)) - 2, STAGE_W, STAGE_H * 0.2 * (1 - d) + 2);
      g.drawRect(0, 0, STAGE_W * 0.14 * (1 - d) + 2, STAGE_H);
      g.drawRect(STAGE_W - (STAGE_W * 0.14 * (1 - d)) - 2, 0, STAGE_W * 0.14 * (1 - d) + 2, STAGE_H);
      g.endFill();
    }
    g.lineStyle(1, RED, 0.1).moveTo(0, STAGE_H * 0.74).lineTo(STAGE_W, STAGE_H * 0.74);
    // The room is 26 stacked circles the size of the stage and 64 translucent
    // rects over the top of them — a wall of blended overdraw that never
    // changes by a pixel. Bake it once and hang the result up as a single quad
    // rather than re-blending all ninety shapes on every frame of every spin.
    // One screen resolution is plenty: it is nothing but soft gradients.
    const baked = app.renderer.generateTexture(g, {
      resolution: 1, region: new PIXI.Rectangle(0, 0, STAGE_W, STAGE_H),
    });
    g.destroy();
    app.stage.addChild(new PIXI.Sprite(baked));
  }

  /* ---------- reels ---------- */
  const reels = [];
  let message = null, fsBanner = null;

  function buildMachine() {
    const machine = new PIXI.Container();
    machine.pivot.set(GRID_W / 2, GRID_H / 2);
    machine.position.set(STAGE_W / 2, MACHINE_Y);
    app.stage.addChild(machine);

    const cabinet = new PIXI.Graphics();
    cabinet.beginFill(PANEL).drawRoundedRect(-22, -22, GRID_W + 44, GRID_H + 44, 16).endFill();
    cabinet.lineStyle(1, HAIRLINE).drawRoundedRect(-22, -22, GRID_W + 44, GRID_H + 44, 16);
    cabinet.lineStyle(1, RED, 0.42).drawRoundedRect(-13, -13, GRID_W + 26, GRID_H + 26, 11);
    cabinet.lineStyle(0);
    cabinet.beginFill(PANEL_DK).drawRect(-4, -4, GRID_W + 8, GRID_H + 8).endFill();
    machine.addChild(cabinet);

    const reelContainer = new PIXI.Container();
    machine.addChild(reelContainer);

    for (let i = 0; i < REELS; i++) {
      const rc = new PIXI.Container();
      rc.x = i * CELL;
      reelContainer.addChild(rc);
      const reel = {
        container: rc, symbols: [], position: 0, previousPosition: 0,
        velocity: 0, state: "idle", spinUntil: Infinity, blur: new BlurFilter(8, 1),
      };
      // One vertical pass is all a motion-blurred reel needs. Quality 3 buys
      // three ping-ponged render targets per reel per frame — eighteen across
      // the machine — for a smoothness nothing travelling that fast can show.
      // Clamping the edge pixels pins the padding at zero, which matters more
      // than it looks: every write to blurY recomputes padding from the blur
      // strength, so without this the filter texture grew by up to 48px on all
      // four sides at exactly the moment the reels were at full speed.
      reel.blur.blurX = 0;
      reel.blur.blurY = 0;
      reel.blur.repeatEdgePixels = true;
      reel.blur.autoFit = false;
      reel.blur.resolution = 1;
      for (let j = 0; j < BAND; j++) {
        const s = new PIXI.Sprite(textures[0]);
        s.anchor.set(0.5);
        s.x = CELL / 2;
        s.y = j * CELL;
        setSymbol(s, randomSymbolId());
        reel.symbols.push(s);
        rc.addChild(s);
      }
      reels.push(reel);
    }

    const mask = new PIXI.Graphics();
    mask.beginFill(0xffffff).drawRect(0, 0, GRID_W, GRID_H).endFill();
    machine.addChild(mask);
    reelContainer.mask = mask;

    const lines = new PIXI.Graphics();
    lines.lineStyle(1, 0xffffff, 0.055);
    for (let c = 1; c < REELS; c++) lines.moveTo(c * CELL, 0).lineTo(c * CELL, GRID_H);
    for (let r = 1; r < ROWS; r++) lines.moveTo(0, r * CELL).lineTo(GRID_W, r * CELL);
    machine.addChild(lines);

    const title = new PIXI.Text("LE SHOOVY", new PIXI.TextStyle({
      fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
      fontSize: 58, fontWeight: "700", fill: "#d92c2c",
      stroke: "#000000", strokeThickness: 6, lineJoin: "round",
      dropShadow: true, dropShadowColor: "#c62828", dropShadowAlpha: 0.35,
      dropShadowBlur: 14, dropShadowDistance: 0, letterSpacing: 10,
    }));
    title.anchor.set(0.5);
    title.position.set(STAGE_W / 2 + 5, 48);   // +5 optically centres the trailing letter-space
    app.stage.addChild(title);

    message = new PIXI.Text("Tap spin to play", new PIXI.TextStyle({
      fontFamily: "Georgia, serif", fontSize: 28, fill: BONE, letterSpacing: 3,
    }));
    message.anchor.set(0.5);
    message.position.set(STAGE_W / 2, 700);
    app.stage.addChild(message);

    fsBanner = new PIXI.Text("", new PIXI.TextStyle({
      fontFamily: "Georgia, serif", fontSize: 24, fontWeight: "700",
      fill: ["#ffffff", "#e03131"], fillGradientType: 1,
      stroke: "#000000", strokeThickness: 4, letterSpacing: 5,
      dropShadow: true, dropShadowColor: "#c62828", dropShadowAlpha: 0.5,
      dropShadowBlur: 12, dropShadowDistance: 0,
    }));
    fsBanner.anchor.set(0.5);
    fsBanner.position.set(STAGE_W / 2, 746);
    fsBanner.visible = false;
    app.stage.addChild(fsBanner);
  }

  function setSymbol(sprite, id) {
    sprite.symbolId = id;
    sprite.texture = textures[id];
    sprite.scale.set((CELL - 14) / sprite.texture.width);
  }
  function spriteAt(reel, row) {
    const p = Math.round(reel.position);
    return reel.symbols[(((row + 1 - p) % BAND) + BAND) % BAND];
  }

  /* ---------- tweens + spin physics (ported from the standalone machine) ----------
     Everything is timed off the wall clock rather than off accumulated frame
     deltas: a slow machine then drops animation smoothness instead of
     stretching the spin out. Only the integration step is clamped. */
  const tweening = [];
  const now = () => performance.now();
  const lerp = (a, b, t) => a * (1 - t) + b * t;
  const backout = (amount) => (t) => --t * t * ((amount + 1) * t + amount) + 1;
  const MAX_SPEED = 17, ACCEL = 55, SETTLE_MS = 620;

  function tweenTo(object, property, target, time, easing, oncomplete) {
    tweening.push({ object, property, target, easing, time,
                    from: object[property], complete: oncomplete, start: now() });
  }

  // The landing symbols are written the instant a reel starts braking: at rest
  // the sprite showing row r is the one where (position + index) % BAND == r+1,
  // so the whole band can be filled from the server's column in one pass. The
  // spare band slot is the one parked just above the window.
  function dressReel(reel, index, position) {
    const column = st.pending ? st.pending.grid[index] : null;
    for (let j = 0; j < BAND; j++) {
      const slot = (((position + j) % BAND) + BAND) % BAND;
      setSymbol(reel.symbols[j], slot === 0 || !column ? randomSymbolId() : column[slot - 1]);
    }
  }

  app.ticker.add(() => {
    const t = now();
    const dt = Math.min(app.ticker.elapsedMS, 50) / 1000;

    reels.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (r.state === "accel") {
        r.velocity = Math.min(MAX_SPEED, r.velocity + ACCEL * dt);
        if (r.velocity === MAX_SPEED) r.state = "spin";
      }
      if (r.state === "accel" || r.state === "spin") {
        r.position += r.velocity * dt;
        if (r.state === "spin" && t >= r.spinUntil) {
          r.state = "stop";
          const target = Math.ceil(r.position + r.velocity * 0.32);
          dressReel(r, i, target);
          tweenTo(r, "position", target, SETTLE_MS, backout(0.35), () => {
            r.state = "idle";
            r.velocity = 0;
            audio.reelStop(i);
            if (reels.every((x) => x.state === "idle")) reelsComplete();
          });
        }
      }
    });

    for (let i = tweening.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const tw = tweening[i];
      const phase = Math.min(1, (t - tw.start) / tw.time);
      tw.object[tw.property] = lerp(tw.from, tw.target, tw.easing(phase));
      if (phase === 1) {
        tw.object[tw.property] = tw.target;
        tweening.splice(i, 1);
        if (tw.complete) tw.complete();
      }
    }

    for (const r of reels) {
      const speed = (r.position - r.previousPosition) / dt;
      r.previousPosition = r.position;
      const blur = Math.min(24, Math.abs(speed) * 1.4);
      if (blur > 0.4) {
        r.blur.blurY = blur;
        if (!r.container.filters) r.container.filters = [r.blur];
      } else if (r.container.filters) {
        r.container.filters = null;
      }
      const wrapped = ((r.position % BAND) + BAND) % BAND;
      for (let j = 0; j < BAND; j++) {
        const s = r.symbols[j];
        const prevY = s.y;
        s.y = ((wrapped + j) % BAND) * CELL - CELL * 0.5;
        // A symbol that wraps back to the top gets a fresh face — but only
        // while the reel is still free-running, never once it's been dressed.
        if (s.y < prevY - CELL && (r.state === "accel" || r.state === "spin")) {
          setSymbol(s, randomSymbolId());
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Park the renderer while the machine is off screen — or simply at rest.
  // A cabinet nobody has spun is a still picture, and redrawing it sixty times
  // a second costs the same blur passes, background overdraw and 36 sprite
  // transforms as a real spin does.
  //
  // A spin already in flight keeps its frames wherever the page is looking:
  // the reels coming down is what applies the payout, so it has to finish even
  // if you tab away mid-spin. The win pulse and the animated tiles are only
  // decoration and can wait until the cabinet is back on screen.
  function moving() {
    if (st.running || tweening.length > 0 || reels.some((r) => r.state !== "idle")) return true;
    return st.visible && (st.pulse !== null || livingTiles.length > 0);
  }
  // Anything that changes the stage while the ticker is parked has to come back
  // through here — it paints one last frame on the way down, so the machine is
  // never left showing a stale grid.
  function syncTicker() {
    if (moving()) { app.ticker.start(); return; }
    app.ticker.stop();
    app.render();
  }
  new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    st.visible = entries[0].isIntersecting;
    syncTicker();
  }).observe(stageEl);

  /* ---------- presentation ---------- */
  function setMessage(text) { if (message) message.text = text; }
  function updateBanner() {
    $("sl-free").textContent = st.free;
    if (!fsBanner) return;
    fsBanner.visible = st.free > 0;
    fsBanner.text = "FREE SPINS  " + st.free + " LEFT   ×" + (SLOT_INFO ? SLOT_INFO.fs_mult : 2);
  }
  function resetSymbols() {
    stopPulse();
    for (const r of reels) {
      for (const s of r.symbols) {
        s.alpha = 1;
        s.scale.set((CELL - 14) / s.texture.width);
      }
    }
  }
  function stopPulse() {
    if (!st.pulse) return;
    app.ticker.remove(st.pulse);
    st.pulse = null;
  }
  function highlight(cells) {
    const winners = new Set(cells);
    const sprites = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < REELS; c++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
        const s = spriteAt(reels[c], row);
        const win = winners.has(c + ":" + row);
        s.alpha = win ? 1 : 0.28;
        if (win) sprites.push(s);
      }
    }
    const base = sprites.map((s) => s.scale.x);
    const from = now();
    st.pulse = () => {
      const elapsed = now() - from;
      const k = 1 + Math.sin(elapsed / 90) * 0.07;
      sprites.forEach((s, i) => s.scale.set(base[i] * k));
      if (elapsed > 1500 || st.running) {
        sprites.forEach((s, i) => s.scale.set(base[i]));
        stopPulse();
        syncTicker();
      }
    };
    app.ticker.add(st.pulse);
  }

  function paintStats() {
    $("sl-spins").textContent = st.spins;
    $("sl-wins").textContent = st.wins;
    $("sl-best").textContent = fmt(st.best);
    $("sl-bestx").textContent = st.bestX ? st.bestX + "×" : "—";
    const p = $("sl-profit");
    p.textContent = (st.profit < 0 ? "-" : "") + fmt(Math.abs(st.profit));
    p.style.color = st.profit > 0 ? "#62d96b" : st.profit < 0 ? "var(--pk-danger)" : "";
  }

  /* Like plinko and keno: the primary button plays a round in manual, and
     starts/stops the run in auto — where it has to stay clickable mid-spin or
     a run could never be stopped. */
  function setControls() {
    const locked = st.running || !st.ready || !st.loggedIn;
    const auto = st.mode === "auto";
    btn.textContent = auto ? (st.auto ? "Stop Autobet" : "Start Autobet")
      : st.free > 0 ? "Free spin (" + st.free + " left)" : "Spin";
    btn.classList.toggle("stop", st.auto);
    btn.disabled = st.auto ? false : locked || st.chain !== null;
    const holdBet = locked || st.free > 0 || st.auto;
    $("sl-bet").disabled = $("sl-half").disabled = $("sl-double").disabled = holdBet;
    for (const id of ["sl-manual", "sl-auto", "sl-auto-count"]) $(id).disabled = st.auto;
  }

  function setMode(mode) {
    st.mode = mode;
    $("sl-manual").classList.toggle("active", mode === "manual");
    $("sl-auto").classList.toggle("active", mode === "auto");
    $("sl-auto-block").classList.toggle("pk-hidden", mode !== "auto");
    setControls();
  }

  function startAuto() {
    if (!st.ready || !st.loggedIn) return;
    const n = parseInt($("sl-auto-count").value || "0", 10);
    const bad = !isFinite(n) || n < 0;
    $("sl-auto-count").classList.toggle("bad", bad);
    $("sl-auto-msg").textContent = bad ? "This must be greater than or equal to 0." : "";
    if (bad) return;
    st.auto = true;
    st.autoLeft = n === 0 ? null : n;   // 0 means "until I say stop"
    setControls();
    if (!st.running && st.chain === null) spin();
  }

  function stopAuto() {
    if (!st.auto) return;
    st.auto = false;
    st.autoLeft = null;
    if (st.chain !== null && !st.running && st.free === 0) {
      clearTimeout(st.chain);
      st.chain = null;
    }
    setControls();
  }

  /* One paid spin off the counter, once a spin has settled. Free spins are the
     feature playing itself out — nothing is staked, so they don't count against
     the run, and a feature won on the last bet still plays out in full. */
  function countAuto(d) {
    if (!st.auto || d.free || st.autoLeft === null) return;
    $("sl-auto-count").value = --st.autoLeft;
    if (st.autoLeft <= 0) stopAuto();
  }
  function queue(ms, fn) {
    st.chain = setTimeout(() => { st.chain = null; setControls(); fn(); }, ms);
    setControls();
  }

  /* ---------- a spin ---------- */
  function brake() {
    // even an instant answer gets a full spin out of the reels
    const t0 = Math.max(now(), st.spinStart + (st.error ? 250 : 700));
    reels.forEach((r, i) => { r.spinUntil = t0 + i * 230 + Math.random() * 120; });
  }

  async function spin() {
    if (st.running || !st.ready) return;
    clearTimeout(st.chain);
    st.chain = null;
    const free = st.free > 0;
    const bet = Math.floor(Number($("sl-bet").value) || 0);
    if (!free) {
      if (!(bet >= 1)) { msg.textContent = "Bet at least 1 credit."; stopAuto(); return; }
      if (bet > BALANCE) { msg.textContent = "Can't bet more than your balance!"; stopAuto(); return; }
    }
    msg.textContent = "";
    const round = ++st.round;   // a late answer from an abandoned spin is dropped
    st.running = true;
    st.pending = null;
    st.error = null;
    st.spinStart = now();
    setControls();
    syncTicker();
    resetSymbols();
    setMessage(free ? "Free spin" : "Good luck");
    hint.className = "hint";
    hint.textContent = free ? "Free spin — no stake deducted." : "Spinning…";
    audio.spin();
    for (const r of reels) { r.state = "accel"; r.spinUntil = Infinity; }
    // if the answer never arrives the reels still have to come down
    st.watchdog = setTimeout(() => {
      if (round === st.round && st.running && !st.pending && !st.error) {
        st.error = "No answer from the server — nothing was staked.";
        brake();
      }
    }, 9000);

    try {
      const r = await fetch("/api/slots/spin", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bet }),
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (round !== st.round) return;
      if (!r.ok) { st.error = d.error; brake(); return; }
      st.pending = d;
      if (!d.free) setBalance(BALANCE - d.stake);   // the payout lands with the reels
      brake();
    } catch (e) {
      if (round !== st.round) return;
      st.error = "Connection lost — try again.";
      brake();
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(st.watchdog);
    }
  }

  function symbolName(id) {
    const d = symDefs.find((s) => s.id === id);
    return d ? d.label : "?";
  }
  function describe(d) {
    return d.wins.map((w) => w.symbol === SCATTER_ID
      ? w.reels + " scatters · " + w.multiplier + "×"
      : symbolName(w.symbol) + " on " + w.reels + " reels · " + w.multiplier + "×").join(", ");
  }

  function reelsComplete() {
    st.running = false;
    const d = st.pending;
    st.pending = null;

    if (!d) {   // the spin never happened — say so instead of pretending it did
      setMessage("—");
      hint.className = "hint loss";
      hint.textContent = st.error || "Spin cancelled — nothing was staked.";
      msg.textContent = st.error || "";
      st.error = null;
      stopAuto();
      setControls();
      syncTicker();
      return;
    }

    st.spins++;
    st.free = d.free_spins;
    st.stake = d.stake;
    st.profit += d.payout - (d.free ? 0 : d.stake);
    if (d.payout > 0) {
      st.wins++;
      st.best = Math.max(st.best, d.payout);
      st.bestX = Math.max(st.bestX, d.multiplier);
    }
    setBalance(d.balance);
    if (window.plinkoRefreshUI) plinkoRefreshUI();
    paintStats();
    updateBanner();
    if (d.cells.length) highlight(d.cells);

    if (window.sfx) {
      if (d.payout > 0) (d.awarded > 0 || d.multiplier >= 10 ? sfx.bigwin() : sfx.win());
      else if (!d.free) sfx.lose();
    }

    if (d.awarded > 0) {
      setMessage(d.scatters + " SCATTERS — " + d.awarded + " FREE SPINS");
      hint.className = "hint win";
      hint.textContent = d.scatters + " scatters — " + d.awarded + " free spins at "
        + fmt(d.stake) + " a spin, every win doubled!"
        + (d.payout > 0 ? " Scatter pay +" + fmt(d.payout) + "." : "");
    } else if (d.payout > 0) {
      setMessage((d.free ? "FREE SPIN WIN " : "WIN ") + fmt(d.payout));
      hint.className = "hint win";
      hint.textContent = "Paid " + credits(d.payout) + " — " + describe(d)
        + (d.free ? " (doubled)" : "") + " 🎉";
    } else {
      setMessage(d.free ? "No win — free spin" : "No win");
      hint.className = "hint loss";
      hint.textContent = d.free ? "No win on this free spin." : "No win — spin again 💀";
    }

    countAuto(d);
    setControls();
    syncTicker();

    if (st.free > 0) {                     // the feature drives itself
      queue(d.awarded > 0 ? 1900 : 1300, () => { if (!st.running) spin(); });
      return;
    }
    if (d.feature_done) {                  // let the last spin read before the summary
      queue(1700, () => {
        if (st.running) return;
        setMessage("FEATURE PAID " + fmt(d.feature_win));
        hint.className = "hint win";
        hint.textContent = "Free spins finished — the feature paid "
          + credits(d.feature_win) + " in total. 🎉";
        syncTicker();   // the ticker is parked by now — paint the summary
        if (window.sfx) sfx.bigwin();
        if (st.auto) queue(900, () => { if (st.auto && !st.running) spin(); });
      });
      return;
    }
    if (st.auto) {
      if (Math.floor(Number($("sl-bet").value) || 0) > BALANCE) {
        stopAuto();
        msg.textContent = "Autobet stopped — not enough credits for the next spin.";
        return;
      }
      queue(1200, () => { if (st.auto && !st.running) spin(); });
    }
  }

  /* ---------- paytable ---------- */
  let SLOT_INFO = null;

  function chip(s) {
    const cls = s.kind === "scatter" ? "scatter"
      : s.kind === "glyph" ? "glyph" + (isRed(s.colour) ? " red" : "") : "rank";
    const face = s.image
      ? '<img src="' + s.image + '" alt="' + s.label + '">'
      : s.label;
    return '<span class="sl-sym ' + cls + '" style="color:' + s.colour + '">' + face + "</span>";
  }
  function buildPaytable(info) {
    const groups = [];
    for (const s of info.symbols) {
      if (!s.pays) continue;
      const key = JSON.stringify(s.pays);
      const found = groups.find((g) => g.key === key);
      if (found) found.syms.push(s);
      else groups.push({ key, syms: [s], pays: s.pays });
    }
    const cols = [3, 4, 5, 6];
    let html = '<table class="sl-table"><thead><tr><th>Symbol</th>'
      + cols.map((c) => "<th>" + c + " reels</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    for (const g of groups) {
      html += "<tr><td>" + g.syms.map(chip).join("") + "</td>"
        + cols.map((c) => "<td>" + (g.pays[c] !== undefined ? g.pays[c] + "×" : "—") + "</td>").join("")
        + "</tr>";
    }
    html += "</tbody></table>";
    const scatter = info.symbols.find((s) => s.id === info.scatter_id);
    const pays = Object.keys(info.scatter_pays)
      .map((n) => n + (n === "5" ? "+" : "") + " pays " + info.scatter_pays[n] + "×").join(", ");
    const award = Object.keys(info.fs_award)
      .map((n) => n + (n === "5" ? "+" : "") + " → " + info.fs_award[n]).join(", ");
    html += '<div class="sl-fs">' + chip(scatter)
      + "<p><b>FREE SPINS</b>Scatters pay from anywhere on the grid (" + pays
      + ") and award free spins (" + award + "). The feature replays your triggering bet, "
      + "every win is multiplied by " + info.fs_mult
      + ", and 3 more scatters retrigger it. Free spins you're owed are kept safe — "
      + "they wait for you through a reload.</p></div>";
    $("sl-paytable").innerHTML = html;
  }

  /* ---------- wiring ---------- */
  btn.onclick = () => {
    if (st.mode === "manual") spin();
    else if (st.auto) stopAuto();
    else startAuto();
  };
  $("sl-manual").onclick = () => { if (window.sfx) sfx.click(); setMode("manual"); };
  $("sl-auto").onclick = () => { if (window.sfx) sfx.click(); setMode("auto"); };
  const betMin = () => Math.max(1, Number($("sl-bet").min) || 1);
  $("sl-half").onclick = () => {
    $("sl-bet").value = Math.max(betMin(), Math.floor(Number($("sl-bet").value || 0) / 2));
  };
  $("sl-double").onclick = () => doubleBet($("sl-bet"));

  btn.disabled = true;
  (async () => {
    const info = await (await fetch("/api/games/info")).json();
    applyCasinoState(info.casino_enabled);
    if (info.bet_min) { $("sl-bet").value = info.bet_min; $("sl-bet").min = info.bet_min; }
    if (!info.slots) { hint.textContent = "Slots are unavailable right now."; return; }

    SLOT_INFO = info.slots;
    SCATTER_ID = info.slots.scatter_id;
    symDefs = info.slots.symbols;
    totalWeight = symDefs.reduce((a, d) => a + d.weight, 0);
    await loadSymbolArt(symDefs);
    textures = bakeSymbols(symDefs);
    playAnimatedSymbols();
    paintScene();
    buildMachine();
    buildPaytable(info.slots);
    st.ready = true;
    st.loggedIn = info.logged_in;
    setControls();
    syncTicker();

    if (!info.logged_in) {
      hint.textContent = "Log in on the home page to play.";
      return;
    }
    hint.textContent = DEFAULT_HINT;
    try {
      const d = await (await fetch("/api/slots/state")).json();
      if (d.feature) {   // free spins owed from an earlier session
        st.free = d.feature.free_spins;
        st.stake = d.feature.stake;
        $("sl-bet").value = d.feature.stake;
        updateBanner();
        setControls();
        setMessage(st.free + " FREE SPINS WAITING");
        hint.className = "hint win";
        hint.textContent = "You still have " + st.free + " free spins at "
          + fmt(st.stake) + " a spin — press spin to play them out.";
        syncTicker();   // the banner landed on a machine that is already at rest
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
})();

/* ================= BLACKJACK =================
   Felt-table blackjack: cards fly out of the shoe and the hole card flips in
   3D. The server is still the only authority — every deal/hit/stand round
   trips to /api/blackjack/*, and the animation just replays what came back. */
(() => {
  const shoeEl = $("bj-shoe"), toastEl = $("bj-toast"), hint = $("bj-hint");
  const dealerEl = $("bj-dealer"), dealerBadge = $("bj-dealer-badge"), playerRow = $("bj-player");
  const DEFAULT_HINT = hint.textContent;
  const fmt = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const reduced = window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const wait = (ms) => sleep(reduced ? 0 : ms);

  /* Card voices: a soft slide across the felt plus a struck wooden bar.
     Round outcomes keep using the shared sfx so the casino sounds alike. */
  const audio = (() => {
    let ctx = null, bus = null;
    function ac() {
      if (!ctx) {
        ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        bus = ctx.createGain(); bus.gain.value = 0.5;
        const soften = ctx.createBiquadFilter();  // shave off any brittle top end
        soften.type = "lowpass"; soften.frequency.value = 4800; soften.Q.value = 0.3;
        bus.connect(soften); soften.connect(ctx.destination);
      }
      if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
      return ctx;
    }
    function wood(freq, t0, gain, decay) {
      const c = ac(), t = c.currentTime + t0;
      const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
      o.type = "sine";
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.88, t + Math.min(0.06, decay));
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain, t + 0.006);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + decay);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(bus);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t + decay + 0.05);
    }
    function slide(dur, cutoff, gain) {
      const c = ac(), t = c.currentTime;
      const len = Math.floor(c.sampleRate * dur);
      const buf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const src = c.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
      const lp = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass";
      lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(cutoff, t);
      lp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(cutoff * 0.45, t + dur);
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(gain, t + 0.035);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
      src.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(bus);
      src.start(t); src.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
    }
    const safe = (fn) => { try { fn(); } catch (e) {} };
    return {
      deal: () => safe(() => { slide(0.16, 950, 0.045); wood(392, 0.05, 0.045, 0.16); }),
      flip: () => safe(() => { slide(0.12, 1400, 0.035); wood(523, 0.03, 0.035, 0.14); }),
      chip: () => safe(() => { wood(587, 0, 0.05, 0.18); wood(880, 0.055, 0.035, 0.16); }),
      bust: () => safe(() => [330, 262, 196].forEach((f, i) => wood(f, i * 0.075, 0.075, 0.35))),
    };
  })();

  // st.view is the last server state; `shown` mirrors what's on the table, so
  // each response only has to animate the cards that aren't out there yet.
  // Every flow that paints takes the next ticket (st.gen); an older flow parked
  // on an await sees its ticket go stale and stops touching the table. Two
  // writers on one row is how a resumed hand landing mid-deal used to leave
  // duplicate cards, a hole card that never flipped, and a badge adding up
  // cards that were never on the table.
  const st = { view: null, busy: false, loggedIn: false, hands: [], holeEl: null, gen: 0 };
  const shown = { dealer: [], hands: [] };
  const claim = () => ++st.gen;
  const stale = (ticket) => ticket !== st.gen;

  function handTotal(cards) {
    let total = 0, aces = 0;
    for (const code of cards) {
      const rank = code.slice(0, -1);
      if (rank === "A") { total += 11; aces++; }
      else if (["J", "Q", "K"].includes(rank)) total += 10;
      else total += Number(rank) || 0;
    }
    while (total > 21 && aces) { total -= 10; aces--; }
    return total;
  }

  // The animations only ever append, so they assume the table already holds a
  // prefix of the hand the server just described. Anything else — a round that
  // moved on in another tab, a repaint that landed mid-animation — has to be
  // painted from the server's view rather than animated onto a stale table.
  const isPrefix = (mirror, cards) =>
    mirror.length <= cards.length && mirror.every((code, i) => code === cards[i]);
  function mirrorMatches(game) {
    // mid-hand only the up card is comparable: the hole card is still "??"
